1	-- test_init.lua — structural and behavioral tests for hammerspoon/init.lua
2	--
3	-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
4	-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
5	--
6	-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
7	--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
8	--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
9	--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
10	--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
11	--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
12	--
13	-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
14	--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
15	--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)
16	
17	local HOME   = os.getenv("HOME")
18	local TARGET = _G.LW_TARGET or (HOME .. "/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua")
19	local OUT    = _G.LW_OUT or "/tmp/lw_test_init.txt"
20	
21	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
22	-- Harness
23	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
24	
25	local results = {}
26	
27	local function record(name, passed, detail)
28	    results[#results + 1] = {
29	        name   = name,
30	        passed = passed and true or false,
31	        detail = detail or "",
32	    }
33	end
34	
35	local function check(name, passed, detail)
36	    record(name, passed, passed and "" or (detail or ""))
37	end
38	
39	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
40	-- Source loading + lexical helpers
41	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	local function readSource(path)
44	    local f = io.open(path, "r")
45	    if not f then return nil end
46	    local src = f:read("*a")
47	    f:close()
48	    return src
49	end
50	
51	local src = readSource(TARGET)
52	if not src then
53	    record("source readable", false, "cannot open " .. TARGET)
54	    local f = io.open(OUT, "w")
55	    f:write("FAIL\tsource readable\tcannot open " .. TARGET .. "\n")
56	    f:close()
57	    return
58	end
59	
60	local lines = {}
61	for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
62	    lines[#lines + 1] = line
63	end
64	
65	-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
66	local function strip(line)
67	    line = line:gsub('"[^"]*"', '""')
68	    line = line:gsub("'[^']*'", "''")
69	    line = line:gsub("%-%-.*$", "")
70	    return line
71	end
72	
73	local stripped = {}
74	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end
75	
76	-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
77	local function usesName(line, name)
78	    return line:find("%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") ~= nil
79	end
80	
81	-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
82	-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
83	--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
84	--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
85	-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
86	local function readsOnly(s)
87	    s = s:gsub("%.%s*[%w_]+", " ")
88	    s = s:gsub(":%s*[%w_]+", " ")
89	    s = s:gsub("[%w_]+%s*=[^=]", " ")
90	    return s
91	end
92	
93	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
94	-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
95	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
97	-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
98	-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
99	-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
100	-- assertions work.
101	
102	local function baseEnv()
103	    return {
104	        math = math, string = string, table = table, os = os,
105	        tostring = tostring, tonumber = tonumber, type = type,
106	        ipairs = ipairs, pairs = pairs, select = select,
107	    }
108	end
109	
110	local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
111	    return load(chunk, name or "sandbox", "t", env)
112	end
113	
114	-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
115	-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
116	local function extractFunction(name)
117	    local startLine
118	    for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
119	        if s:match("^local%s+function%s+" .. name .. "%s*%(") then startLine = i break end
120	    end
121	    if not startLine then return nil end
122	    for i = startLine + 1, #lines do
123	        if stripped[i]:match("^end%s*$") then
124	            return table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, startLine, i) }, "\n")
125	        end
126	    end
127	    return nil
128	end
129	
130	-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
131	local function liftFunction(name, env)
132	    local fnSrc = extractFunction(name)
133	    if not fnSrc then return nil, "could not locate local function " .. name .. "()" end
134	    local factory, err = loadIn(fnSrc .. "\nreturn " .. name, env, name)
135	    if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
136	    return factory()
137	end
138	
139	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	-- 1. Syntax
141	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
142	
143	local chunk, loadErr = loadfile(TARGET)
144	check("syntax: file compiles", chunk ~= nil, tostring(loadErr))
145	
146	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
147	-- 2. Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling (AGENTS.md hard limit)
148	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	
150	local topLevelLocals = 0
151	for _, s in ipairs(stripped) do
152	    if s:match("^local%s") then topLevelLocals = topLevelLocals + 1 end
153	end
154	check("locals: top-level count within Lua's 200 ceiling",
155	      topLevelLocals <= 200,
156	      "found " .. topLevelLocals .. " top-level locals (limit 200)")
157	
158	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
159	-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
160	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
161	-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
162	-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
163	-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
164	-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).
165	
166	-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
167	local decls = {}
168	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
169	    local fname = s:match("^local%s+function%s+([%w_]+)")
170	    if fname then
171	        decls[fname] = decls[fname] or i
172	    else
173	        local names = s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]-)%s*=") or s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]+)%s*$")
174	        if names then
175	            for n in names:gmatch("[%w_]+") do
176	                if n ~= "function" then decls[n] = decls[n] or i end
177	            end
178	        end
179	    end
180	end
181	
182	-- A name is "shadowed" before line `upto` if some earlier line binds it as a local,
183	-- a function parameter, or a loop variable -- in which case an earlier textual use
184	-- refers to that binding, not to the top-level one, and is not a bug.
185	local function shadowedBefore(name, upto)
186	    for i = 1, upto - 1 do
187	        local s = stripped[i]
188	        if s:match("%f[%w_]local%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
189	        if s:match("%f[%w_]for%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
190	        local params = s:match("function%s*(%b())")
191	        if params and usesName(params, name) then return true end
192	    end
193	    return false
194	end
195	
196	local violations = {}
197	for name, declLine in pairs(decls) do
198	    for i = 1, declLine - 1 do
199	        if usesName(readsOnly(stripped[i]), name) and not shadowedBefore(name, i + 1) then
200	            violations[#violations + 1] = string.format("%s used at L%d, declared at L%d", name, i, declLine)
201	            break
202	        end
203	    end
204	end
205	table.sort(violations)
206	check("scope: no top-level local used before its declaration",
207	      #violations == 0,
208	      table.concat(violations, "; "))
209	
210	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
211	-- 4. No unguarded system-sound playback
212	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
213	-- hs.sound.getByFile returns nil when the file is missing or AudioToolbox fails to
214	-- load it; indexing that nil throws and aborts whatever callback is mid-flight,
215	-- which previously stranded the overlay on screen. All playback goes through
216	-- playSound(), which nil-checks.
217	
218	local unguarded = {}
219	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
220	    if s:find("hs%.sound%.getByFile%s*%b()%s*:%s*play") then
221	        unguarded[#unguarded + 1] = "L" .. i
222	    end
223	end
224	check("sound: no unguarded getByFile():play()",
225	      #unguarded == 0,
226	      "unguarded playback at " .. table.concat(unguarded, ", "))
227	
228	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
229	-- 5. Meeting mode stays removed
230	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
231	
232	local meetingHits = {}
233	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
234	    local low = s:lower()
235	    if low:find("meeting") or low:find("blackhole") or low:find("aggregate") then
236	        meetingHits[#meetingHits + 1] = "L" .. i
237	    end
238	end
239	check("meeting: no meeting-mode code remains",
240	      #meetingHits == 0,
241	      "found at " .. table.concat(meetingHits, ", "))
242	
243	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
244	-- 6. No unintended top-level globals
245	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
246	-- AGENTS.md: never leak state into Hammerspoon's shared _ENV, where another config
247	-- or Spoon can collide with it. A short allowlist covers the deliberate ones.
248	
249	local allowedGlobals = {
250	    _whisper       = true,  -- state probe for `hs -c`
251	    WhisperActions = true,  -- user-facing action-hook API
252	    emergencyStop  = true,  -- called from the overlay callback and the menu bar
253	    updateMenuBar  = true,
254	    stopRecording  = true,
255	}
256	
257	-- `decls` holds every top-level local, including forward declarations. Assigning to
258	-- one of those (e.g. `hideOverlay = function() ... end`) writes the local, not a global.
259	local leaked = {}
260	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
261	    -- top-level `name = ...` (not local, not indented, not a comparison)
262	    local name = s:match("^([%w_]+)%s*=[^=]")
263	    if name and not allowedGlobals[name] and not decls[name] then
264	        leaked[#leaked + 1] = name .. " (L" .. i .. ")"
265	    end
266	    local gfn = s:match("^function%s+([%w_]+)%s*%(")
267	    if gfn and not allowedGlobals[gfn] and not decls[gfn] then
268	        leaked[#leaked + 1] = gfn .. "() (L" .. i .. ")"
269	    end
270	end
271	check("globals: no unintended top-level globals",
272	      #leaked == 0,
273	      "leaked: " .. table.concat(leaked, ", "))
274	
275	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
276	-- 7. Chunk ordering (behavioral -- exercises the real comparator)
277	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
278	-- The comparator is extracted from the source under test rather than reimplemented,
279	-- so this test tracks the real implementation instead of a copy that can drift.
280	
281	local cmpSrc = src:match("table%.sort%(chunks,%s*(function%s*%(a,%s*b%).-end)%)")
282	if not cmpSrc then
283	    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", false,
284	          "could not locate table.sort(chunks, function(a, b) ... end)")
285	else
286	    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", true)
287	    local factory, err = load("return " .. cmpSrc)
288	    if not factory then
289	        check("sort: comparator compiles", false, tostring(err))
290	    else
291	        check("sort: comparator compiles", true)
292	        local cmp = factory()
293	
294	        -- ffmpeg writes chunk_%03d.wav, which overflows past 999. Build an
295	        -- out-of-order list spanning the overflow boundary.
296	        local indices = { 1200, 3, 1000, 999, 0, 100, 1001, 99, 1 }
297	        local files = {}
298	        for _, n in ipairs(indices) do
299	            files[#files + 1] = string.format("/tmp/chunks/chunk_%03d.wav", n)
300	        end
301	        table.sort(files, cmp)
302	
303	        local got = {}
304	        for _, f in ipairs(files) do got[#got + 1] = tonumber(f:match("chunk_(%d+)%.wav$")) end
305	
306	        local expect = { 0, 1, 3, 99, 100, 999, 1000, 1001, 1200 }
307	        local same = #got == #expect
308	        if same then
309	            for i = 1, #expect do
310	                if got[i] ~= expect[i] then same = false break end
311	            end
312	        end
313	        check("sort: chunks order numerically across the 999 boundary", same,
314	              "got " .. table.concat(got, ",") .. " want " .. table.concat(expect, ","))
315	
316	        -- Guard the specific regression: 999 must precede 1000, which plain
317	        -- lexicographic sorting gets wrong ("chunk_1000" < "chunk_999").
318	        local pos = {}
319	        for i, n in ipairs(got) do pos[n] = i end
320	        check("sort: chunk 999 precedes chunk 1000 (lexicographic would not)",
321	              pos[999] and pos[1000] and pos[999] < pos[1000],
322	              "999 at index " .. tostring(pos[999]) .. ", 1000 at index " .. tostring(pos[1000]))
323	    end
324	end
325	
326	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
327	-- 8. Chunk filename pattern stays in sync between writer and reader
328	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
329	-- ffmpeg's -segment output template and the sort comparator's pattern must agree;
330	-- changing one without the other silently breaks ordering again.
331	
332	local writerPattern = src:find('chunk_%%03d%.wav', 1, false) ~= nil
333	local readerPattern = src:find('chunk_%(%%d%+%)%%%.wav', 1, false) ~= nil
334	check("sort: ffmpeg output template and comparator pattern agree",
335	      writerPattern and readerPattern,
336	      "writer chunk_%03d.wav=" .. tostring(writerPattern) ..
337	      ", reader chunk_(%d+)%.wav=" .. tostring(readerPattern))
338	
339	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
340	-- 9. Emergency stop cancels pending finalization
341	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
342	-- Otherwise the timer armed by stopRecording() still fires after the user hits
343	-- Emergency Stop, and pastes the transcript into whatever is focused by then.
344	
345	local esStart, esEnd
346	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
347	    if s:match("^function%s+emergencyStop%s*%(") then esStart = i end
348	    if esStart and not esEnd and i > esStart and s:match("^end%s*$") then esEnd = i end
349	end
350	if not (esStart and esEnd) then
351	    check("emergencyStop: function body is locatable", false, "could not find emergencyStop()")
352	else
353	    check("emergencyStop: function body is locatable", true)
354	    local body = table.concat({ table.unpack(stripped, esStart, esEnd) }, "\n")
355	    check("emergencyStop: clears finalizationPending",
356	          body:find("finalizationPending%s*=%s*false") ~= nil,
357	          "emergencyStop() does not clear finalizationPending")
358	    check("emergencyStop: stops the finalization timers",
359	          body:find("finalizeTimers%.timer") ~= nil and body:find("finalizeTimers%.watchdog") ~= nil,
360	          "emergencyStop() does not stop finalizeTimers.timer/.watchdog")
361	end
362	
363	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
364	-- 10. Overlay state is declared above the callback that closes over it
365	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
366	-- The generic scan above is heuristic; these three names are the ones that actually
367	-- broke (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning), so pin the invariant explicitly.
368	
369	local createLine
370	for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
371	    if s:match("^local%s+function%s+createOverlay%s*%(") then createLine = i break end
372	end
373	if not createLine then
374	    check("overlay: createOverlay() is locatable", false, "could not find createOverlay()")
375	else
376	    check("overlay: createOverlay() is locatable", true)
377	    local late = {}
378	    for _, name in ipairs({ "overlayPinned", "isRecording", "hideOverlay" }) do
379	        if not decls[name] or decls[name] > createLine then
380	            late[#late + 1] = name .. " (declared at L" .. tostring(decls[name]) .. ")"
381	        end
382	    end
383	    check("overlay: pin/recording state is declared above createOverlay",
384	          #late == 0,
385	          "declared below createOverlay (L" .. createLine .. "): " .. table.concat(late, ", "))
386	end
387	
388	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
389	-- 11. Overlay click behavior (behavioral -- runs the real mouse callback)
390	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
391	-- Two live bugs live here: clicking X mid-recording used to hide the overlay while
392	-- ffmpeg kept running, and deleting the canvas from inside its own mouse callback is
393	-- silently ignored by hs.canvas, so the delete must stay deferred.
394	
395	local cbSrc = src:match("overlay:mouseCallback(%b())")
396	if not cbSrc then
397	    check("overlay: mouse callback is extractable from source", false,
398	          "could not locate overlay:mouseCallback(function(canvas, event, id, ...) ... end)")
399	else
400	    check("overlay: mouse callback is extractable from source", true)
401	
402	    -- Click the overlay and return the resulting stub state. Deferred work is captured
403	    -- rather than run, so a test can assert on both sides of the hs.timer.doAfter.
404	    local function click(opts)
405	        local env    = baseEnv()
406	        local calls  = { hide = 0, delete = 0, emergency = 0, hideOverlay = 0 }
407	        local defer  = {}
408	        local canvas = {
409	            [1]    = { fillColor = {} },
410	            hide   = function() calls.hide = calls.hide + 1 end,
411	            delete = function() calls.delete = calls.delete + 1 end,
412	        }
413	        env.log           = function() end
414	        env.isRecording   = opts.recording and true or false
415	        env.overlayPinned = opts.pinned and true or false
416	        env.overlay       = canvas
417	        env.emergencyStop = function() calls.emergency = calls.emergency + 1 end
418	        env.hideOverlay   = function() calls.hideOverlay = calls.hideOverlay + 1 end
419	        env.hs = { timer = { doAfter = function(d, fn) defer[#defer + 1] = { delay = d, fn = fn } end } }
420	
421	        local factory, err = loadIn("return " .. cbSrc, env, "mouseCallback")
422	        if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
423	        -- A raw error here would abort the whole suite, so report it as a failure instead.
424	        local ok, runErr = pcall(factory(), canvas, opts.event, opts.id, 0, 0)
425	        if not ok then return nil, "callback errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
426	        return { env = env, calls = calls, defer = defer, canvas = canvas }
427	    end
428	
429	    local probe, probeErr = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = true })
430	    check("overlay: mouse callback compiles", probe ~= nil, tostring(probeErr))
431	
432	    if probe then
433	        -- X mid-recording: hide now, tear down on the deferred pass.
434	        check("overlay: X hides the canvas immediately",
435	              probe.calls.hide == 1, "canvas:hide() called " .. probe.calls.hide .. " times")
436	        check("overlay: X defers the canvas delete (deleting inside the callback is ignored)",
437	              #probe.defer == 1 and probe.calls.delete == 0,
438	              #probe.defer .. " deferred call(s), delete called " .. probe.calls.delete .. " times synchronously")
439	
440	        if #probe.defer == 1 then
441	            probe.defer[1].fn()
442	            check("overlay: X during recording stops the recording",
443	                  probe.calls.emergency == 1,
444	                  "emergencyStop() called " .. probe.calls.emergency .. " times")
445	            check("overlay: X during recording leaves teardown to emergencyStop",
446	                  probe.calls.delete == 0,
447	                  "overlay:delete() called directly instead of via emergencyStop()")
448	            check("overlay: X unpins the overlay",
449	                  probe.env.overlayPinned == false,
450	                  "overlayPinned = " .. tostring(probe.env.overlayPinned))
451	        end
452	
453	        -- X while idle: no recording to stop, so the callback owns the teardown.
454	        local idle = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = true })
455	        if idle and #idle.defer == 1 then
456	            idle.defer[1].fn()
457	            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle",
458	                  idle.calls.delete == 1 and idle.env.overlay == nil,
459	                  "delete called " .. idle.calls.delete .. " times, overlay = " .. tostring(idle.env.overlay))
460	            check("overlay: X while idle does not call emergencyStop",
461	                  idle.calls.emergency == 0,
462	                  "emergencyStop() called " .. idle.calls.emergency .. " times")
463	        else
464	            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle", false,
465	                  "expected exactly one deferred call, got " .. tostring(idle and #idle.defer))
466	        end
467	
468	        -- mouseUp on the X must not fall through to the background pin toggle.
469	        local upOnX = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = false })
470	        check("overlay: mouseUp on X does not toggle pinning",
471	              upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned == false and upOnX.calls.hide == 0,
472	              "overlayPinned = " .. tostring(upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned))
473	
474	        -- Unpinning must not hide the overlay while a recording is still running.
475	        local unpinRec = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = true, pinned = true })
476	        check("overlay: unpinning mid-recording keeps the overlay on screen",
477	              unpinRec and unpinRec.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay == 0,
478	              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinRec and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while recording")
479	
480	        local unpinIdle = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = false, pinned = true })
481	        check("overlay: unpinning while idle hides the overlay",
482	              unpinIdle and unpinIdle.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay == 1,
483	              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinIdle and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while idle")
484	    end
485	end
486	
487	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
488	-- 12. startRecording re-press recovery (behavioral)
489	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
490	-- Pressing the trigger again inside the 0.3s finalization window must flush the
491	-- pending dictation AND start the new one. Returning after the flush swallowed the
492	-- keypress -- the user held the key and nothing recorded.
493	
494	local function pressTrigger(state)
495	    local env   = baseEnv()
496	    local calls = { final = 0, warmup = 0, overlayText = 0, showOverlay = 0 }
497	    local timerStub = function(tag)
498	        return { stop = function() calls["stopped_" .. tag] = true end }
499	    end
500	
501	    env.log                  = function() end
502	    env.isRecording          = state.recording and true or false
503	    env.isWarmingUp          = state.warmingUp and true or false
504	    env.finalizationPending  = state.pending and true or false
505	    env.warmupAttempt        = 7  -- non-zero, so the reset is observable
506	    env.finalizeTimers       = { timer = timerStub("timer"), watchdog = timerStub("watchdog") }
507	    env.doFinalTranscription = function() calls.final = calls.final + 1 end
508	    env.setOverlayText       = function() calls.overlayText = calls.overlayText + 1 end
509	    env.showOverlay          = function() calls.showOverlay = calls.showOverlay + 1 end
510	    env.tryWarmup            = function() calls.warmup = calls.warmup + 1 end
511	
512	    local fn, err = liftFunction("startRecording", env)
513	    if not fn then return nil, err end
514	    local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
515	    if not ok then return nil, "startRecording() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
516	    return { env = env, calls = calls }
517	end
518	
519	local repress, repressErr = pressTrigger({ pending = true })
520	check("startRecording: function is liftable and compiles", repress ~= nil, tostring(repressErr))
521	
522	if repress then
523	    check("startRecording: a pending finalization is flushed on re-press",
524	          repress.calls.final == 1,
525	          "doFinalTranscription() called " .. repress.calls.final .. " times")
526	    check("startRecording: re-press still starts the new recording (keypress not swallowed)",
527	          repress.calls.warmup == 1 and repress.env.isWarmingUp == true,
528	          "tryWarmup() called " .. repress.calls.warmup .. " times, isWarmingUp = " ..
529	          tostring(repress.env.isWarmingUp))
530	    check("startRecording: the flush cancels both finalization timers",
531	          repress.calls.stopped_timer and repress.calls.stopped_watchdog and
532	          repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer == nil and repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog == nil,
533	          "timer stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_timer) ..
534	          " watchdog stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_watchdog) ..
535	          " timer=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer) ..
536	          " watchdog=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog))
537	    check("startRecording: the flush clears finalizationPending",
538	          repress.env.finalizationPending == false,
539	          "finalizationPending = " .. tostring(repress.env.finalizationPending))

541	          repress.calls.showOverlay == 1 and repress.calls.overlayText == 1,
542	          "showOverlay=" .. repress.calls.showOverlay .. " setOverlayText=" .. repress.calls.overlayText)
543	
544	    local plain = pressTrigger({})
545	    check("startRecording: with nothing pending it just starts recording",
546	          plain and plain.calls.final == 0 and plain.calls.warmup == 1,
547	          "doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.final) ..
548	          " tryWarmup=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.warmup))
549	
550	    local busy = pressTrigger({ recording = true, pending = true })
551	    check("startRecording: no-ops while already recording",
552	          busy and busy.calls.warmup == 0 and busy.calls.final == 0,
553	          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.warmup) ..
554	          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.final))
555	
556	    local warming = pressTrigger({ warmingUp = true, pending = true })
557	    check("startRecording: no-ops while already warming up",
558	          warming and warming.calls.warmup == 0 and warming.calls.final == 0,
559	          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.warmup) ..
560	          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.final))
561	end
562	
563	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
564	-- 13. Progress bar reaches 100% (behavioral)
565	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
566	-- Left on the live clock, `elapsed` keeps climbing during transcription and re-trips
567	-- the 90% auto-expand on every finished segment, so barMaxSecs outruns transcribedSecs
568	-- and the blue bar never catches the red one. stopRecordingIndicator() freezes the
569	-- duration into recordedSecs; updateProgressBar() must honour it.
570	
571	local elSrc = src:match("local%s+EL%s*=%s*(%b{})")
572	local EL = elSrc and loadIn("return " .. elSrc, baseEnv(), "EL")
573	EL = EL and EL()
574	check("progress: EL element-index table is extractable", type(EL) == "table",
575	      "could not read `local EL = { ... }` from source")
576	
577	if type(EL) == "table" then
578	    -- Drive updateProgressBar() over a scripted timeline of (clock, transcribedSecs).
579	    local function runBar(steps, recordedSecs)
580	        local env  = baseEnv()
581	        local now  = 0
582	        env.EL     = EL
583	        env.overlay = { [EL.bar_rec] = {}, [EL.bar_txn] = {} }
584	        env.recordingStartTime = 0
585	        env.recordedSecs       = recordedSecs
586	        env.transcribedSecs    = 0
587	        env.barMaxSecs         = 180
588	        env.hs = { timer = { secondsSinceEpoch = function() return now end } }
589	
590	        local fn, err = liftFunction("updateProgressBar", env)
591	        if not fn then return nil, err end
592	        for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
593	            now = step[1]
594	            env.transcribedSecs = step[2]
595	            if step[3] ~= nil then env.recordedSecs = step[3] end
596	            local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
597	            if not ok then return nil, "updateProgressBar() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
598	        end
599	        return {
600	            rec = env.overlay[EL.bar_rec].frame.w,
601	            txn = env.overlay[EL.bar_txn].frame.w,
602	            barMaxSecs = env.barMaxSecs,
603	            env = env,
604	        }
605	    end
606	
607	    -- 100s of audio, then transcription finishes while the wall clock runs on to 240s
608	    -- (past 0.9 * 180 = 162s, which is what used to re-trip the auto-expand).
609	    local bar, barErr = runBar({
610	        { 60,  0 },              -- mid-recording
611	        { 100, 0 },              -- key released at 100s
612	        { 130, 33,  100 },       -- stopRecordingIndicator() froze recordedSecs = 100
613	        { 170, 66 },
614	        { 240, 100 },            -- all 100s transcribed
615	    })
616	    check("progress: updateProgressBar is liftable and compiles", bar ~= nil, tostring(barErr))
617	
618	    if bar then
619	        check("progress: the blue bar reaches the red bar when transcription completes",
620	              bar.txn == bar.rec,
621	              "transcribed bar w=" .. bar.txn .. ", recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec)
622	        check("progress: the bar scale stops expanding once recording stops",
623	              bar.barMaxSecs == 180,
624	              "barMaxSecs grew to " .. bar.barMaxSecs .. " after the recording ended")
625	        check("progress: the bars are drawn at a visible width",
626	              bar.rec == math.floor((100 / 180) * 386),
627	              "recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec .. ", want " .. math.floor((100 / 180) * 386))
628	
629	        -- Half-transcribed audio must still read as half, not as full.
630	        local partial = runBar({ { 100, 0 }, { 300, 50, 100 } })
631	        check("progress: a partially transcribed recording shows a partial blue bar",
632	              partial and partial.txn < partial.rec and partial.txn > 1,
633	              "transcribed w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.txn) ..
634	              ", recorded w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.rec))
635	
636	        -- The freeze must not disable the auto-expand for genuinely long recordings.
637	        local long = runBar({ { 60, 0 }, { 170, 0 } })
638	        check("progress: the bar still auto-expands during a long recording",
639	              long and long.barMaxSecs == 360,
640	              "barMaxSecs = " .. tostring(long and long.barMaxSecs) .. " at 170s recorded (want 360)")
641	    end
642	
643	    -- The two halves of the freeze contract that updateProgressBar depends on.
644	    local startBody = extractFunction("startRecordingIndicator")
645	    local stopBody  = extractFunction("stopRecordingIndicator")
646	    check("progress: startRecordingIndicator clears the frozen duration",
647	          startBody ~= nil and startBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*nil") ~= nil,
648	          "startRecordingIndicator() does not reset recordedSecs = nil")
649	    check("progress: stopRecordingIndicator freezes the recorded duration",
650	          stopBody ~= nil and stopBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*hs%.timer%.secondsSinceEpoch") ~= nil,
651	          "stopRecordingIndicator() does not freeze recordedSecs from the clock")
652	
653	    -- BAR_MAX in updateProgressBar and the bar_bg track width in createOverlay are
654	    -- separate literals; drifting apart would misreport progress at the right edge.
655	    local barMax  = src:match("local%s+BAR_MAX%s*=%s*(%d+)")
656	    local trackW  = src:match('id%s*=%s*"bar_bg".-w%s*=%s*(%d+)')
657	    check("progress: BAR_MAX matches the bar_bg track width",
658	          barMax ~= nil and barMax == trackW,
659	          "BAR_MAX=" .. tostring(barMax) .. ", bar_bg w=" .. tostring(trackW))
660	end
661	
662	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
663	-- Emit results
664	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
665	
666	local out = io.open(OUT, "w")
667	for _, r in ipairs(results) do
668	    out:write((r.passed and "PASS" or "FAIL") .. "\t" .. r.name .. "\t" .. r.detail .. "\n")
669	end

-- test_init.lua — structural and behavioral tests for hammerspoon/init.lua
--
-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
--
-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
--
-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)

local HOME   = os.getenv("HOME")
local TARGET = _G.LW_TARGET or (HOME .. "/Documents/GitHub/local-whisper/hammerspoon/init.lua")
local OUT    = _G.LW_OUT or "/tmp/lw_test_init.txt"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Harness
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local results = {}

local function record(name, passed, detail)
    results[#results + 1] = {
        name   = name,
        passed = passed and true or false,
        detail = detail or "",
    }
end

local function check(name, passed, detail)
    record(name, passed, passed and "" or (detail or ""))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Source loading + lexical helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function readSource(path)
    local f = io.open(path, "r")
    if not f then return nil end
    local src = f:read("*a")
    f:close()
    return src
end

local src = readSource(TARGET)
if not src then
    record("source readable", false, "cannot open " .. TARGET)
    local f = io.open(OUT, "w")
    f:write("FAIL\tsource readable\tcannot open " .. TARGET .. "\n")
    f:close()
    return
end

local lines = {}
for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
    lines[#lines + 1] = line
end

-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
local function strip(line)
    line = line:gsub('"[^"]*"', '""')
    line = line:gsub("'[^']*'", "''")
    line = line:gsub("%-%-.*$", "")
    return line
end

local stripped = {}
for i, l in ipairs(lines) do stripped[i] = strip(l) end

-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
local function usesName(line, name)
    return line:find("%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") ~= nil
end

-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
local function readsOnly(s)
    s = s:gsub("%.%s*[%w_]+", " ")
    s = s:gsub(":%s*[%w_]+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("[%w_]+%s*=[^=]", " ")
    return s
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
-- assertions work.

local function baseEnv()
    return {
        math = math, string = string, table = table, os = os,
        tostring = tostring, tonumber = tonumber, type = type,
        ipairs = ipairs, pairs = pairs, select = select,
    }
end

local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
    return load(chunk, name or "sandbox", "t", env)
end

-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
local function extractFunction(name)
    local startLine
    for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
        if s:match("^local%s+function%s+" .. name .. "%s*%(") then startLine = i break end
    end
    if not startLine then return nil end
    for i = startLine + 1, #lines do
        if stripped[i]:match("^end%s*$") then
            return table.concat({ table.unpack(lines, startLine, i) }, "\n")
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
local function liftFunction(name, env)
    local fnSrc = extractFunction(name)
    if not fnSrc then return nil, "could not locate local function " .. name .. "()" end
    local factory, err = loadIn(fnSrc .. "\nreturn " .. name, env, name)
    if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
    return factory()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Syntax
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local chunk, loadErr = loadfile(TARGET)
check("syntax: file compiles", chunk ~= nil, tostring(loadErr))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling (AGENTS.md hard limit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local topLevelLocals = 0
for _, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    if s:match("^local%s") then topLevelLocals = topLevelLocals + 1 end
end
check("locals: top-level count within Lua's 200 ceiling",
      topLevelLocals <= 200,
      "found " .. topLevelLocals .. " top-level locals (limit 200)")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).

-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
local decls = {}
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    local fname = s:match("^local%s+function%s+([%w_]+)")
    if fname then
        decls[fname] = decls[fname] or i
    else
        local names = s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]-)%s*=") or s:match("^local%s+([%w_%s,]+)%s*$")
        if names then
            for n in names:gmatch("[%w_]+") do
                if n ~= "function" then decls[n] = decls[n] or i end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- A name is "shadowed" before line `upto` if some earlier line binds it as a local,
-- a function parameter, or a loop variable -- in which case an earlier textual use
-- refers to that binding, not to the top-level one, and is not a bug.
local function shadowedBefore(name, upto)
    for i = 1, upto - 1 do
        local s = stripped[i]
        if s:match("%f[%w_]local%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
        if s:match("%f[%w_]for%f[^%w_][^=]*%f[%w_]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then return true end
        local params = s:match("function%s*(%b())")
        if params and usesName(params, name) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local violations = {}
for name, declLine in pairs(decls) do
    for i = 1, declLine - 1 do
        if usesName(readsOnly(stripped[i]), name) and not shadowedBefore(name, i + 1) then
            violations[#violations + 1] = string.format("%s used at L%d, declared at L%d", name, i, declLine)
            break
        end
    end
end
table.sort(violations)
check("scope: no top-level local used before its declaration",
      #violations == 0,
      table.concat(violations, "; "))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. No unguarded system-sound playback
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hs.sound.getByFile returns nil when the file is missing or AudioToolbox fails to
-- load it; indexing that nil throws and aborts whatever callback is mid-flight,
-- which previously stranded the overlay on screen. All playback goes through
-- playSound(), which nil-checks.

local unguarded = {}
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    if s:find("hs%.sound%.getByFile%s*%b()%s*:%s*play") then
        unguarded[#unguarded + 1] = "L" .. i
    end
end
check("sound: no unguarded getByFile():play()",
      #unguarded == 0,
      "unguarded playback at " .. table.concat(unguarded, ", "))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. Meeting mode stays removed
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local meetingHits = {}
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    local low = s:lower()
    if low:find("meeting") or low:find("blackhole") or low:find("aggregate") then
        meetingHits[#meetingHits + 1] = "L" .. i
    end
end
check("meeting: no meeting-mode code remains",
      #meetingHits == 0,
      "found at " .. table.concat(meetingHits, ", "))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. No unintended top-level globals
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AGENTS.md: never leak state into Hammerspoon's shared _ENV, where another config
-- or Spoon can collide with it. A short allowlist covers the deliberate ones.

local allowedGlobals = {
    _whisper       = true,  -- state probe for `hs -c`
    WhisperActions = true,  -- user-facing action-hook API
    emergencyStop  = true,  -- called from the overlay callback and the menu bar
    updateMenuBar  = true,
    stopRecording  = true,
}

-- `decls` holds every top-level local, including forward declarations. Assigning to
-- one of those (e.g. `hideOverlay = function() ... end`) writes the local, not a global.
local leaked = {}
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    -- top-level `name = ...` (not local, not indented, not a comparison)
    local name = s:match("^([%w_]+)%s*=[^=]")
    if name and not allowedGlobals[name] and not decls[name] then
        leaked[#leaked + 1] = name .. " (L" .. i .. ")"
    end
    local gfn = s:match("^function%s+([%w_]+)%s*%(")
    if gfn and not allowedGlobals[gfn] and not decls[gfn] then
        leaked[#leaked + 1] = gfn .. "() (L" .. i .. ")"
    end
end
check("globals: no unintended top-level globals",
      #leaked == 0,
      "leaked: " .. table.concat(leaked, ", "))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. Chunk ordering (behavioral -- exercises the real comparator)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The comparator is extracted from the source under test rather than reimplemented,
-- so this test tracks the real implementation instead of a copy that can drift.

local cmpSrc = src:match("table%.sort%(chunks,%s*(function%s*%(a,%s*b%).-end)%)")
if not cmpSrc then
    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", false,
          "could not locate table.sort(chunks, function(a, b) ... end)")
else
    check("sort: comparator is extractable from source", true)
    local factory, err = load("return " .. cmpSrc)
    if not factory then
        check("sort: comparator compiles", false, tostring(err))
    else
        check("sort: comparator compiles", true)
        local cmp = factory()

        -- ffmpeg writes chunk_%03d.wav, which overflows past 999. Build an
        -- out-of-order list spanning the overflow boundary.
        local indices = { 1200, 3, 1000, 999, 0, 100, 1001, 99, 1 }
        local files = {}
        for _, n in ipairs(indices) do
            files[#files + 1] = string.format("/tmp/chunks/chunk_%03d.wav", n)
        end
        table.sort(files, cmp)

        local got = {}
        for _, f in ipairs(files) do got[#got + 1] = tonumber(f:match("chunk_(%d+)%.wav$")) end

        local expect = { 0, 1, 3, 99, 100, 999, 1000, 1001, 1200 }
        local same = #got == #expect
        if same then
            for i = 1, #expect do
                if got[i] ~= expect[i] then same = false break end
            end
        end
        check("sort: chunks order numerically across the 999 boundary", same,
              "got " .. table.concat(got, ",") .. " want " .. table.concat(expect, ","))

        -- Guard the specific regression: 999 must precede 1000, which plain
        -- lexicographic sorting gets wrong ("chunk_1000" < "chunk_999").
        local pos = {}
        for i, n in ipairs(got) do pos[n] = i end
        check("sort: chunk 999 precedes chunk 1000 (lexicographic would not)",
              pos[999] and pos[1000] and pos[999] < pos[1000],
              "999 at index " .. tostring(pos[999]) .. ", 1000 at index " .. tostring(pos[1000]))
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. Chunk filename pattern stays in sync between writer and reader
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ffmpeg's -segment output template and the sort comparator's pattern must agree;
-- changing one without the other silently breaks ordering again.

local writerPattern = src:find('chunk_%%03d%.wav', 1, false) ~= nil
local readerPattern = src:find('chunk_%(%%d%+%)%%%.wav', 1, false) ~= nil
check("sort: ffmpeg output template and comparator pattern agree",
      writerPattern and readerPattern,
      "writer chunk_%03d.wav=" .. tostring(writerPattern) ..
      ", reader chunk_(%d+)%.wav=" .. tostring(readerPattern))

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 9. Emergency stop cancels pending finalization
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Otherwise the timer armed by stopRecording() still fires after the user hits
-- Emergency Stop, and pastes the transcript into whatever is focused by then.

local esStart, esEnd
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    if s:match("^function%s+emergencyStop%s*%(") then esStart = i end
    if esStart and not esEnd and i > esStart and s:match("^end%s*$") then esEnd = i end
end
if not (esStart and esEnd) then
    check("emergencyStop: function body is locatable", false, "could not find emergencyStop()")
else
    check("emergencyStop: function body is locatable", true)
    local body = table.concat({ table.unpack(stripped, esStart, esEnd) }, "\n")
    check("emergencyStop: clears finalizationPending",
          body:find("finalizationPending%s*=%s*false") ~= nil,
          "emergencyStop() does not clear finalizationPending")
    check("emergencyStop: stops the finalization timers",
          body:find("finalizeTimers%.timer") ~= nil and body:find("finalizeTimers%.watchdog") ~= nil,
          "emergencyStop() does not stop finalizeTimers.timer/.watchdog")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 10. Overlay state is declared above the callback that closes over it
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The generic scan above is heuristic; these three names are the ones that actually
-- broke (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning), so pin the invariant explicitly.

local createLine
for i, s in ipairs(stripped) do
    if s:match("^local%s+function%s+createOverlay%s*%(") then createLine = i break end
end
if not createLine then
    check("overlay: createOverlay() is locatable", false, "could not find createOverlay()")
else
    check("overlay: createOverlay() is locatable", true)
    local late = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({ "overlayPinned", "isRecording", "hideOverlay" }) do
        if not decls[name] or decls[name] > createLine then
            late[#late + 1] = name .. " (declared at L" .. tostring(decls[name]) .. ")"
        end
    end
    check("overlay: pin/recording state is declared above createOverlay",
          #late == 0,
          "declared below createOverlay (L" .. createLine .. "): " .. table.concat(late, ", "))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 11. Overlay click behavior (behavioral -- runs the real mouse callback)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Two live bugs live here: clicking X mid-recording used to hide the overlay while
-- ffmpeg kept running, and deleting the canvas from inside its own mouse callback is
-- silently ignored by hs.canvas, so the delete must stay deferred.

local cbSrc = src:match("overlay:mouseCallback(%b())")
if not cbSrc then
    check("overlay: mouse callback is extractable from source", false,
          "could not locate overlay:mouseCallback(function(canvas, event, id, ...) ... end)")
else
    check("overlay: mouse callback is extractable from source", true)

    -- Click the overlay and return the resulting stub state. Deferred work is captured
    -- rather than run, so a test can assert on both sides of the hs.timer.doAfter.
    local function click(opts)
        local env    = baseEnv()
        local calls  = { hide = 0, delete = 0, emergency = 0, hideOverlay = 0 }
        local defer  = {}
        local canvas = {
            [1]    = { fillColor = {} },
            hide   = function() calls.hide = calls.hide + 1 end,
            delete = function() calls.delete = calls.delete + 1 end,
        }
        env.log           = function() end
        env.isRecording   = opts.recording and true or false
        env.overlayPinned = opts.pinned and true or false
        env.overlay       = canvas
        env.emergencyStop = function() calls.emergency = calls.emergency + 1 end
        env.hideOverlay   = function() calls.hideOverlay = calls.hideOverlay + 1 end
        env.hs = { timer = { doAfter = function(d, fn) defer[#defer + 1] = { delay = d, fn = fn } end } }

        local factory, err = loadIn("return " .. cbSrc, env, "mouseCallback")
        if not factory then return nil, tostring(err) end
        -- A raw error here would abort the whole suite, so report it as a failure instead.
        local ok, runErr = pcall(factory(), canvas, opts.event, opts.id, 0, 0)
        if not ok then return nil, "callback errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
        return { env = env, calls = calls, defer = defer, canvas = canvas }
    end

    local probe, probeErr = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = true })
    check("overlay: mouse callback compiles", probe ~= nil, tostring(probeErr))

    if probe then
        -- X mid-recording: hide now, tear down on the deferred pass.
        check("overlay: X hides the canvas immediately",
              probe.calls.hide == 1, "canvas:hide() called " .. probe.calls.hide .. " times")
        check("overlay: X defers the canvas delete (deleting inside the callback is ignored)",
              #probe.defer == 1 and probe.calls.delete == 0,
              #probe.defer .. " deferred call(s), delete called " .. probe.calls.delete .. " times synchronously")

        if #probe.defer == 1 then
            probe.defer[1].fn()
            check("overlay: X during recording stops the recording",
                  probe.calls.emergency == 1,
                  "emergencyStop() called " .. probe.calls.emergency .. " times")
            check("overlay: X during recording leaves teardown to emergencyStop",
                  probe.calls.delete == 0,
                  "overlay:delete() called directly instead of via emergencyStop()")
            check("overlay: X unpins the overlay",
                  probe.env.overlayPinned == false,
                  "overlayPinned = " .. tostring(probe.env.overlayPinned))
        end

        -- X while idle: no recording to stop, so the callback owns the teardown.
        local idle = click({ event = "mouseDown", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = true })
        if idle and #idle.defer == 1 then
            idle.defer[1].fn()
            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle",
                  idle.calls.delete == 1 and idle.env.overlay == nil,
                  "delete called " .. idle.calls.delete .. " times, overlay = " .. tostring(idle.env.overlay))
            check("overlay: X while idle does not call emergencyStop",
                  idle.calls.emergency == 0,
                  "emergencyStop() called " .. idle.calls.emergency .. " times")
        else
            check("overlay: X while idle deletes the overlay and clears the handle", false,
                  "expected exactly one deferred call, got " .. tostring(idle and #idle.defer))
        end

        -- mouseUp on the X must not fall through to the background pin toggle.
        local upOnX = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "close", recording = false, pinned = false })
        check("overlay: mouseUp on X does not toggle pinning",
              upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned == false and upOnX.calls.hide == 0,
              "overlayPinned = " .. tostring(upOnX and upOnX.env.overlayPinned))

        -- Unpinning must not hide the overlay while a recording is still running.
        local unpinRec = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = true, pinned = true })
        check("overlay: unpinning mid-recording keeps the overlay on screen",
              unpinRec and unpinRec.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay == 0,
              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinRec and unpinRec.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while recording")

        local unpinIdle = click({ event = "mouseUp", id = "bg", recording = false, pinned = true })
        check("overlay: unpinning while idle hides the overlay",
              unpinIdle and unpinIdle.env.overlayPinned == false and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay == 1,
              "hideOverlay() called " .. tostring(unpinIdle and unpinIdle.calls.hideOverlay) .. " times while idle")
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 12. startRecording re-press recovery (behavioral)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pressing the trigger again inside the 0.3s finalization window must flush the
-- pending dictation AND start the new one. Returning after the flush swallowed the
-- keypress -- the user held the key and nothing recorded.

local function pressTrigger(state)
    local env   = baseEnv()
    local calls = { final = 0, warmup = 0, overlayText = 0, showOverlay = 0 }
    local timerStub = function(tag)
        return { stop = function() calls["stopped_" .. tag] = true end }
    end

    env.log                  = function() end
    env.isRecording          = state.recording and true or false
    env.isWarmingUp          = state.warmingUp and true or false
    env.finalizationPending  = state.pending and true or false
    env.warmupAttempt        = 7  -- non-zero, so the reset is observable
    env.finalizeTimers       = { timer = timerStub("timer"), watchdog = timerStub("watchdog") }
    env.doFinalTranscription = function() calls.final = calls.final + 1 end
    env.setOverlayText       = function() calls.overlayText = calls.overlayText + 1 end
    env.showOverlay          = function() calls.showOverlay = calls.showOverlay + 1 end
    env.tryWarmup            = function() calls.warmup = calls.warmup + 1 end

    local fn, err = liftFunction("startRecording", env)
    if not fn then return nil, err end
    local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then return nil, "startRecording() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
    return { env = env, calls = calls }
end

local repress, repressErr = pressTrigger({ pending = true })
check("startRecording: function is liftable and compiles", repress ~= nil, tostring(repressErr))

if repress then
    check("startRecording: a pending finalization is flushed on re-press",
          repress.calls.final == 1,
          "doFinalTranscription() called " .. repress.calls.final .. " times")
    check("startRecording: re-press still starts the new recording (keypress not swallowed)",
          repress.calls.warmup == 1 and repress.env.isWarmingUp == true,
          "tryWarmup() called " .. repress.calls.warmup .. " times, isWarmingUp = " ..
          tostring(repress.env.isWarmingUp))
    check("startRecording: the flush cancels both finalization timers",
          repress.calls.stopped_timer and repress.calls.stopped_watchdog and
          repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer == nil and repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog == nil,
          "timer stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_timer) ..
          " watchdog stopped=" .. tostring(repress.calls.stopped_watchdog) ..
          " timer=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.timer) ..
          " watchdog=" .. tostring(repress.env.finalizeTimers.watchdog))
    check("startRecording: the flush clears finalizationPending",
          repress.env.finalizationPending == false,
          "finalizationPending = " .. tostring(repress.env.finalizationPending))
    check("startRecording: the new recording shows the overlay",
          repress.calls.showOverlay == 1 and repress.calls.overlayText == 1,
          "showOverlay=" .. repress.calls.showOverlay .. " setOverlayText=" .. repress.calls.overlayText)

    local plain = pressTrigger({})
    check("startRecording: with nothing pending it just starts recording",
          plain and plain.calls.final == 0 and plain.calls.warmup == 1,
          "doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.final) ..
          " tryWarmup=" .. tostring(plain and plain.calls.warmup))

    local busy = pressTrigger({ recording = true, pending = true })
    check("startRecording: no-ops while already recording",
          busy and busy.calls.warmup == 0 and busy.calls.final == 0,
          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.warmup) ..
          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(busy and busy.calls.final))

    local warming = pressTrigger({ warmingUp = true, pending = true })
    check("startRecording: no-ops while already warming up",
          warming and warming.calls.warmup == 0 and warming.calls.final == 0,
          "tryWarmup=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.warmup) ..
          " doFinalTranscription=" .. tostring(warming and warming.calls.final))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 13. Progress bar reaches 100% (behavioral)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Left on the live clock, `elapsed` keeps climbing during transcription and re-trips
-- the 90% auto-expand on every finished segment, so barMaxSecs outruns transcribedSecs
-- and the blue bar never catches the red one. stopRecordingIndicator() freezes the
-- duration into recordedSecs; updateProgressBar() must honour it.

local elSrc = src:match("local%s+EL%s*=%s*(%b{})")
local EL = elSrc and loadIn("return " .. elSrc, baseEnv(), "EL")
EL = EL and EL()
check("progress: EL element-index table is extractable", type(EL) == "table",
      "could not read `local EL = { ... }` from source")

if type(EL) == "table" then
    -- Drive updateProgressBar() over a scripted timeline of (clock, transcribedSecs).
    local function runBar(steps, recordedSecs)
        local env  = baseEnv()
        local now  = 0
        env.EL     = EL
        env.overlay = { [EL.bar_rec] = {}, [EL.bar_txn] = {} }
        env.recordingStartTime = 0
        env.recordedSecs       = recordedSecs
        env.transcribedSecs    = 0
        env.barMaxSecs         = 180
        env.hs = { timer = { secondsSinceEpoch = function() return now end } }

        local fn, err = liftFunction("updateProgressBar", env)
        if not fn then return nil, err end
        for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
            now = step[1]
            env.transcribedSecs = step[2]
            if step[3] ~= nil then env.recordedSecs = step[3] end
            local ok, runErr = pcall(fn)
            if not ok then return nil, "updateProgressBar() errored: " .. tostring(runErr) end
        end
        return {
            rec = env.overlay[EL.bar_rec].frame.w,
            txn = env.overlay[EL.bar_txn].frame.w,
            barMaxSecs = env.barMaxSecs,
            env = env,
        }
    end

    -- 100s of audio, then transcription finishes while the wall clock runs on to 240s
    -- (past 0.9 * 180 = 162s, which is what used to re-trip the auto-expand).
    local bar, barErr = runBar({
        { 60,  0 },              -- mid-recording
        { 100, 0 },              -- key released at 100s
        { 130, 33,  100 },       -- stopRecordingIndicator() froze recordedSecs = 100
        { 170, 66 },
        { 240, 100 },            -- all 100s transcribed
    })
    check("progress: updateProgressBar is liftable and compiles", bar ~= nil, tostring(barErr))

    if bar then
        check("progress: the blue bar reaches the red bar when transcription completes",
              bar.txn == bar.rec,
              "transcribed bar w=" .. bar.txn .. ", recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec)
        check("progress: the bar scale stops expanding once recording stops",
              bar.barMaxSecs == 180,
              "barMaxSecs grew to " .. bar.barMaxSecs .. " after the recording ended")
        check("progress: the bars are drawn at a visible width",
              bar.rec == math.floor((100 / 180) * 386),
              "recorded bar w=" .. bar.rec .. ", want " .. math.floor((100 / 180) * 386))

        -- Half-transcribed audio must still read as half, not as full.
        local partial = runBar({ { 100, 0 }, { 300, 50, 100 } })
        check("progress: a partially transcribed recording shows a partial blue bar",
              partial and partial.txn < partial.rec and partial.txn > 1,
              "transcribed w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.txn) ..
              ", recorded w=" .. tostring(partial and partial.rec))

        -- The freeze must not disable the auto-expand for genuinely long recordings.
        local long = runBar({ { 60, 0 }, { 170, 0 } })
        check("progress: the bar still auto-expands during a long recording",
              long and long.barMaxSecs == 360,
              "barMaxSecs = " .. tostring(long and long.barMaxSecs) .. " at 170s recorded (want 360)")
    end

    -- The two halves of the freeze contract that updateProgressBar depends on.
    local startBody = extractFunction("startRecordingIndicator")
    local stopBody  = extractFunction("stopRecordingIndicator")
    check("progress: startRecordingIndicator clears the frozen duration",
          startBody ~= nil and startBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*nil") ~= nil,
          "startRecordingIndicator() does not reset recordedSecs = nil")
    check("progress: stopRecordingIndicator freezes the recorded duration",
          stopBody ~= nil and stopBody:find("recordedSecs%s*=%s*hs%.timer%.secondsSinceEpoch") ~= nil,
          "stopRecordingIndicator() does not freeze recordedSecs from the clock")

    -- BAR_MAX in updateProgressBar and the bar_bg track width in createOverlay are
    -- separate literals; drifting apart would misreport progress at the right edge.
    local barMax  = src:match("local%s+BAR_MAX%s*=%s*(%d+)")
    local trackW  = src:match('id%s*=%s*"bar_bg".-w%s*=%s*(%d+)')
    check("progress: BAR_MAX matches the bar_bg track width",
          barMax ~= nil and barMax == trackW,
          "BAR_MAX=" .. tostring(barMax) .. ", bar_bg w=" .. tostring(trackW))
end

for _, r in ipairs(results) do
    out:write((r.passed and "PASS" or "FAIL") .. "\t" .. r.name .. "\t" .. r.detail .. "\n")
